name: Pink World 2
summary:
A young girl named Eileen is excited to start her first day as an intern on a farm. However said farm and by extension the world change forever when a flash of pink light hits.
A sequel to the first Pink World Visual Novel
The story takes place parallel to the first but in a different location, showing the vast reach of the new pink sky, where everyone under it is slowly turned into hot studs and sluts, not knowing that their chosen spoken words have huge implication on their transformation.​
